release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.26 adds an authenticated smartphone browser remote for the PC-hosted game over the same private Wi-Fi/LAN. Pair with an 8-digit code, view up to two open tables, your hole cards, visible board, pot, stack, action status and legal sizing; send Fold, Check, Call, Bet, Raise and All-in actions. Phone commands are queued to the PC Tk main thread and revalidated against current legal actions, turn, table state and bet limits. Only HERO's own cards are sent; CPU hole cards and strategy internals are filtered. The server is LAN-only, rate-limits pairing attempts, uses per-session bearer tokens, and stops when Pigeon Poker closes. The 174-scenario preflop chart, CPU logic, wallet, VIP and casino features remain unchanged.
